item.title: Friday 1 PM Update, Nov 13
item.description:
The Friday 1 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 13, 2026: York, Maine weather through tomorrow; Commerce says Howard Lutnick will testify voluntarily as the Megaspeed feud simmers, Kansas prosecutors decline charges in the Wichita soccer-field crash, and President Trump says he wants to "get Cuba done"; Europe settles on a negotiating team for Ukraine talks and a building collapse near Nairobi kills six; a chip sell-off sinks the Nasdaq while Samsung eyes Modine; Microsoft apologizes and blames a network upgrade; OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet lets agents shop; Project Zero shortens its disclosure clock, PostgreSQL patches 52 flaws and Luna Moth returns to law firms; your X feed; a menhaden quota cut for Maine's bait fishery and Saturday jazz in Kittery; and two teens who paddled to their neighbors' rescue. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Friday 10 AM Update, Nov 13
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Friday Morning, Nov 13
item.description:
